FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Outdoor Venture Gear specializes in the retail of camping and outdoor recreational equipment, focusing on high-quality products that enhance the customer experience in nature. Our operations center on offering a diverse range of items, including tents, sleeping bags, cooking gear, and hiking accessories, all sourced from reputable manufacturers. We prioritize educating our customers through in-store instructional activities and engaging staff training programs that emphasize safety and product knowledge. To mitigate risks, we have implemented strong inventory management systems and maintain documented vendor relationships, ensuring the authenticity and compliance of our products. Our store is equipped with advanced security measures, including monitored burglar alarms, to protect against theft and losses. We adhere strictly to all applicable regulations, including product safety standards, and do not engage in any prohibited activities. This commitment allows us to operate responsibly while providing a safe environment for our customers.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 1, 2023, our store experienced a theft incident whereby assorted camping equipment worth $2,000 was taken from the sales floor. The matter was reported to the local authorities, and a police report was filed. The status of recovery is currently under investigation. Additionally, during a store event on July 15, 2023, a customer tripped over a display and incurred minor injuries; the associated medical expenses amounted to $1,500, which has since been settled amicably without legal claims.
